request_id_convention: r<k> (k = manifest position; record UUIDs mapped via workload_request_id)
within_step_note: dag: criterion of record (COORD ruling M-0177 on DECISION M-0021/M-0031; approved by Daniel 21:33Z, M-0281) -- order-insensitive Merkle DAG multiset per request step, canonical addressing by structural identity, dependency order enforced (G8); the sequence verdict is recorded beside it under alternate_verdict

checks.what: requests_declared: manifest == global Program == record header; none omitted/duplicated; prompts as declared; record engine conditions inside the Program's declared applicability
requests_observed: every declared request has rows + output events + instances; 0 unattributed; no undeclared request
subcircuits_x09: each request's projection canonical-equal to its component over the executed steps (eos-truncated labelled)
identity_map: (request, local step, local index) <-> global node is a bijection over the attributed fold
shared_state: one weights input for all requests (no overlapping fields); node operands same-request, producer step <= consumer step
chronology: declared == realized == observed arrival; contiguous rows; output events = TokenSelects, k-th = k-th token, feed the next row; bounded

stop_rule.rule: an early stop must end in a declared EOS id; else FAIL (F-pm-24)
stop_rule.eos_lag_source: Program lag 1 (TargetProfile.effective_async_scheduling(): not declared in the target; the pinned resolver's value for an admitted profile (vllm/config/vllm.py:1273-1322 (VllmConfig.__post_init__), vLLM d9105ea80)); record attests async_scheduling=True (RunHeader.profile.engine_kwargs, capture/versions.json engine_kwargs)
stop_rule.lag_rule: R17-1: after an EOS stop exactly LAG (the Program's declared static) more row(s) run, each fed the preceding sample, its sample fed nowhere and absent from generated_token_ids (executed_prefix_len = a_r + LAG, served_output_len = a_r); the record must attest the same async_scheduling; undeclared -> refuse by name
stop_rule.evidence: the recorder's SampleEnd token, cross-checked against the driver's tokens.json (output association); the fold TokenSelect VALUE is Commit territory (C3 openings of the sampled ids), not Match's

lag.declared_source: TargetProfile.effective_async_scheduling(): not declared in the target; the pinned resolver's value for an admitted profile (vllm/config/vllm.py:1273-1322 (VllmConfig.__post_init__), vLLM d9105ea80)

lengths.served_output_len: a_r = output events up to and including the first declared EOS id (eos_token_ids), else cap
lengths.executed_prefix_len: a_r + 1 after an EOS stop before the cap (LAG step(s): active internal computation, sampled token NOT served); a_r on a length stop (a_r == cap; an EOS sampled at the cap is a length stop, no post-EOS row)
lengths.cap_exhaustion: a_r == cap (length stop): specified separately from the EOS stop; never widened by the lag
lengths.eos_set: stop_rule.eos_token_ids, NOT widened by the post-EOS row's discarded sample
lengths.inactivity: positions >= a_r + 1 of an EOS-stopped request are programmed-but-unexecuted (bot in the lifted baseline)
lengths.capacity_covers_lag: cap events per request; a_r <= cap - 1 on an EOS stop, so a_r + LAG <= cap for LAG in {0, 1}
lengths.rule: R17-1 / DP-pad-02 (b); one definition for Build (this Program), GM-01 G6 and the finalizer

sampler_geometry.relation: S_t = SplitsFor_v1(|live(t)|, num_SMs): registry/topp_split.splits_for (vLLM _apply_topp_split doubling loop), |live(t)| = requests with a logits row at engine step t (declared chronology and verified EOS), num_SMs declared
sampler_geometry.live_source: scheduled workload state (G6: declared arrivals, served lengths = cap or verified EOS, declared lag rows, prefill chunks) -- the record's logits rows and SampleEnd batch must equal it
sampler_geometry.note: no top-p TokenSelect in the fold: nothing to check

checks.what: vu_population: global query population (components over executed steps) == attributed fold; boundary probes resolve

within_step_order: emission order inside an engine step recorded as batch layout (canonical addresses are structural, DECISION M-0021); dependency order is G3's (a consumer before its producer is DAG-unequal)

segmentation.rule: request-local steps = the request's instances segmented at its TokenSelects (compare.Prog._segment); cross-checked against the engine step the fold rows record for every instance

checks.order_source: request-local canonical order: the component Program; cross-request row interleaving and (under dag) the emission order: runtime batch layout / fold encoding (StepStart.rows), recorded not prescribed
